title: mcp-fetch-server SSRF via private-IP validation bypass (CVE-2025-65513)
summary: fetch-mcp (npm: mcp-fetch-server) versions through 1.0.2 fail to properly validate private IP addresses in their is_ip_private() check, allowing server-side request forgery that reaches internal network resources through the server's URL-fetching tools.

packages.name: mcp-fetch-server
packages.note: No patched version listed at time of advisory publication; restrict egress or remove the server.
